JOINT CONFERENCE COMMITTEE REPORT

We, the conferees, appointed by the respective bodies to consider and report upon the disagreeing vote on Senate Bill No. 94, report as follows:

We recommend that the House Amendment in the Nature of a Substitute (26108333D) be accepted to resolve the matter under disagreement.

Respectfully submitted,

Senator Danica A. Roem (signed)

Senator Kannan Srinivasan (signed)

Senator William M. Stanley, Jr. (signed)

Conferees on the part of the Senate

Delegate Joshua E. Thomas (signed)

Delegate Kelly K. Convirs-Fowler (signed)

Delegate Scott A. Wyatt (not signed)

Conferees on the part of the House
